title: KAZIM KE GHAM ME MOMIN AANSOO BAHARAHE HAIN_
body:
KAZIM KE GHAM ME MOMIN AANSOO BAHARAHE HAIN.
RANJO ALAM KE BADAL HAR DIL PE CHHARAHE HAIN.
1.HAR DIL TADAP RAHA HAI KAZIM KE GHAM MAY DEKHO.
SADME UTHAKE MOULA DUNIYA SE JARAHE HAI.....
<<DIVIDER>>
2.KAISI HAI YE ADAAWAT KTAISI HAI YE SHAQAWAT.
LAASHE PA BHI MAZALIM JO DHAATE JARAHE HAIN.....
<<DIVIDER>>
4.HAI JASR PAR JANAZA KAZIM KA HAAYE GURBAT.
MOULA KE YE MASAYEB HUMKO RULARAHE HAIN.....
<<DIVIDER>>
5.BAGHE JINA KI KHUSHBOO LAASHE SE AARAHI HAI.
JAATE HUWAY BHI KAZIM KHUSHBOO LUTARAHE HAIN.....
<<DIVIDER>>
6.ZEHERE DAGHA SE BABA MARAGAYA HAI MERA.
ROOTEY HUWAY RAZA YE SABKO SUNA RAHE HAIN.....
<<DIVIDER>>
7.MISMAAR KARRAHE HAIN ZAALIM QUBOOR AB BHI.
ISLAM KE MUHAFIZ SADME UTHARAHE HAIN.....
<<DIVIDER>>
8.KYA ZULM O BEBASI KI HADD BHI KOI HAI AAQER.
QALEEN MAY RAKHKE LAASHA ZAALIM DABAARAHE HAIN.....
KAZIM KE GHAM MAY MOMIN AANSOO BAHARAHE HAIN.
AZZ:-Dawar Ali Dawar
